title: 《代数几何基础》简体中文版 / Fondements de la géométrie algébrique (FGA) — Unofficial Simplified-Chinese Edition
description:
This is the first release in the canonical mainland Simplified-Chinese (zh-Hans-CN) FGA language lineage. It contains all eight Séminaire Bourbaki Exposés 149, 182, 190, 195, 212, 221, 232, and 236; the 1962 Commentaires; and all eight linked errata through the end of the erratum to Exposé 236.

The 148-page reader and editable-source archive passed source and witness replay, structural and formula checks, deterministic XeLaTeX convergence, font and glyph checks, text extraction, internal-link validation, archive-member verification, privacy review, and bounded visual inspection. The edition is producer-complete and mechanically/visually verified; it does not claim independent Chinese-language certification.

This is an independent, unofficial translation and typesetting project. It does not imply endorsement by the historical author, the Séminaire Bourbaki, NUMDAM, a publisher, or any institution. NUMDAM scans and French/English witness files are excluded. No new blanket public-domain or open-license claim is made over the underlying FGA text. This language-specific lineage is derived from, but is not a new version within, the earlier shared multilingual record 10.5281/zenodo.22083916. The public repository is KokunoYumeto/fga-zh-hans-cn.
